Markdown.description: Markdown block rendered with the chat renderer.

rows.description: Row values, each row aligned with columns.

Image.description: Image from URL or data URI.

Card.description: Bordered container with an optional title.

Row.description: Horizontal layout container; following components until Column/Divider are its children (simple flow model).

Column.description: Vertical layout container segment; closes the current Row.

tabs.description: Pane list. Each item is an object: {label: string, content: string (markdown)}.

Select.description: Dropdown selection; set multiple=true for multi-select.

Button.description: Action button; action=submit attaches the form answers to the resume payload.

Form.description: Explicit form wrapper with inline field list (alternative to flat input components).

fields.description: Field definitions rendered in order. Each item is an object: {name: string, label: string, type: string, options?: string[], required?: boolean}.

FileDrop.description: File upload dropzone (upload handled by the frontend).

name.description: Answer key for uploaded file references.

TakeoutStoreList.description: Takeout store recommendation cards, laid out as one white card per store in a horizontally scrolling row. Use when suggesting 2+ nearby shops with representative dishes; put each store's dishes in its own card instead of separate components. Omitting `stores` renders the built-in mock demo card.

title.description: Optional caption above the cards, e.g. 附近高分外卖.

stores.description: Stores to recommend (2-6). Each item is an object: {name: string, logo?: string (image URL, or an emoji when there is no URL), badges?: string[] (short tags, rendered green, e.g. ["可堂食"]), rating?: number (out of 5, rendered as 4.5分), minOrder?: number (minimum order amount, rendered as 起送¥15), eta?: number|string (delivery time, a number renders as 28分钟), desc?: string (one or two sentences on why it fits the user), items?: array of representative dishes, actionText?: string (default 进店逛逛), actionValue?: string (the message sent when the user clicks the button; defaults to actionText)}. Each dish object is {name: string, image?: string, sales?: string (e.g. 已售2000+), rank?: string (e.g. 近30天该店热销第2名), price?: number}. Omit a dish price only when genuinely unknown; the meta line is built from rating/minOrder/eta.

TakeoutOrderCard.description: Takeout order confirmation card: shop line, ordered items with specs, delivery and fee rows, then the payable total and action buttons. Use when the user is reviewing or about to place an order; never invent an address or a fee. Omitting every prop renders the built-in mock demo card.

shop.description: Shop header, rendered with a trailing chevron. Shape: {name: string, logo?: string (image URL or emoji)}.

items.description: Ordered dishes (rendered above the divider). Each item is an object: {name: string, image?: string, spec?: string (chosen spec, rendered as an editable-looking chip, e.g. 中辣 / 常温), price?: number (unit price), qty?: number (rendered as x1)}.

rows.description: Label/value rows below the divider, in display order. Each item is an object: {label: string, value?: string|number, hint?: string (grey placeholder in place of value, e.g. 点击说明对商家的要求), notes?: string[] (small orange detail snippets after the value, e.g. the discount breakdown 千问每日必减¥2.2), tone?: string (normal by default; discount and total render in the orange price color, total is bold and larger), clickable?: boolean (trailing chevron for rows the user can reopen, e.g. 送达时间/配送至)}. Make the payable amount the last row with tone total.

actions.description: Buttons below the rows (2 at most). Each item is an object: {text: string, value?: string (message sent on click; defaults to text), kind?: string (primary or ghost; ghost is the neutral shop-entering button), icon?: string (alipay for the payment button)}.
